findings.text: The helper named memset_no_sanitize_memory in its first variant clears memory without sanitizer instrumentation by delegating to an internal fill routine and it accepts a destination plus a fill value plus a length while yielding the destination.

The helper named KMSAN_WARN_ON in its first variant evaluates its predicate once through the generic warning facility and records the outcome and on a true outcome it disables uninitialized memory tracking globally and it may halt execution when a panic flag is set and it finally produces the recorded boolean outcome.

When the detector is disabled the helpers named kmsan_init_shadow and kmsan_init_runtime and kmsan_task_create and kmsan_task_exit and kmsan_alloc_page and kmsan_free_page and kmsan_copy_page_meta and kmsan_slab_alloc and kmsan_slab_free and kmsan_kmalloc_large and kmsan_kfree_large and kmsan_handle_dma and kmsan_handle_dma_sg and kmsan_handle_urb and kmsan_unpoison_entry_regs and kmsan_enable_current and kmsan_disable_current all perform no observable action.

In disabled configuration the helper named kmsan_memblock_free_pages always approves release and the helpers named kmsan_vmap_pages_range_noflush and kmsan_ioremap_page_range report success without action while the helpers named kmsan_vunmap_range_noflush and kmsan_iounmap_page_range do nothing and the second variant of memset_no_sanitize_memory falls back to the ordinary fill routine and the second variant of KMSAN_WARN_ON simply equals the generic warning facility.
Constants named KMSAN_RETVAL_SIZE and KMSAN_PARAM_SIZE both denote eight hundred.

The structure named kmsan_context_state aggregates a byte area named param_tls and a byte area named retval_tls and a byte area named va_arg_tls and a byte area named va_arg_origin_tls and a wide count named va_arg_overflow_size_tls and a byte area named param_origin_tls plus a narrow tag named retval_origin_tls.
The structure named kmsan_ctx embeds the full thread local context named cstate together with a reentrancy flag named kmsan_in_runtime and a nesting depth counter named depth.

The enumeration named lru_status distinguishes removed items and removed items with lock reacquired and referenced items requiring another pass and unlockable items requiring skip and not freeable items requiring retry and walk termination, where the latter two outcomes permit internal lock release provided the lock is held on return. These correspond to outcomes named LRU_REMOVED and LRU_REMOVED_RETRY and LRU_ROTATE and LRU_SKIP and LRU_RETRY and LRU_STOP.
The structure named list_lru_one combines a list anchor named list with a signed live item tally named nr_items that may transiently go negative during group reparenting.
The spinlock named lock inside each LRU shard serializes its list anchor and signed tally.

The structure named list_lru_memcg carries a reclaim header named rcu plus a node indexed shard array named node and the structure named list_lru_node pairs a global shard named lru for the root group with an atomic total named nr_items and requires cacheline alignment and the structure named list_lru holds a node array named node plus optional group list plus shrinker identity plus awareness flag plus indexed store plus lock dependency key under respective options.

Initialization helpers select group unaware versus group aware setup through helpers named list_lru_init and list_lru_init_memcg that delegate to a common initializer with false versus true, with an additional helper named list_lru_init_memcg_key recording a lock dependency key before delegating to group aware setup.
The helper named folio_memcg_list_lru_alloc in this configuration always reports success without action.

Counting helpers named list_lru_shrink_count and list_lru_count serve shrinker queries from a single node and group selection or aggregate per node totals across normal memory nodes, while walking helpers named list_lru_shrink_walk and list_lru_shrink_walk_irq delegate to single node isolation with a shared scan budget including an interrupt safe variant, and the helper named list_lru_walk accumulates isolated items node by node until the budget is exhausted.

Isolation callbacks of type list_lru_walk_cb return a walk outcome and accept at least a list item anchor, but the fragment truncates remaining parameters so full arity and lock expectations beyond the outcome contract are not visible here.
Node iteration has a multi node form named for_each_node_state that traverses a state mask and a single node form with the same name that executes exactly once for node zero.

The flag named MEMBLOCK_NONE denotes zero and the flag named MEMBLOCK_HOTPLUG denotes one and the flag named MEMBLOCK_MIRROR denotes two and the flag named MEMBLOCK_NOMAP denotes four and the flag named MEMBLOCK_DRIVER_MANAGED denotes eight and the flag named MEMBLOCK_RSRV_NOINIT denotes sixteen and the flag named MEMBLOCK_RSRV_KERN denotes thirty two and the flag named MEMBLOCK_KHO_SCRATCH denotes sixty four and the flag named MEMBLOCK_RSRV_HUGETLB denotes one hundred twenty eight.

The structure named memblock_region describes each region by base address named base plus size named size plus flags plus optional node identity named nid, and the structure named memblock_type groups regions into a counted array with current count named cnt plus capacity named max plus total size named total_size plus region pointer named regions plus name named name, and the structure named memblock pairs memory and reserved groups with a direction flag named bottom_up and a current limit named current_limit.

The bound named MEMBLOCK_ALLOC_ANYWHERE denotes all address bits set and the bound named MEMBLOCK_ALLOC_ACCESSIBLE denotes zero and the bound named MEMBLOCK_LOW_LIMIT denotes zero and the ceiling named ARCH_LOW_ADDRESS_LIMIT denotes the thirty two bit maximum and the marker named MEMBLOCK_ALLOC_NOLEAKTRACE denotes one.

The flag named HASH_EARLY denotes one for early boot allocation and the flag named HASH_ZERO denotes two for zeroing and the default named HASHDIST_DEFAULT follows sixty four bit enablement while the selector named hashdist is constantly false in this view.

Range iteration helpers walk physical memory and generic type intersections forward and reverse with a maximal index sentinel, plus memory excluding hotplug and driver managed regions and reserved ranges and page frame ranges and free ranges and reverse free ranges and direct region arrays, through helpers named __next_physmem_range and for_each_physmem_range and __for_each_mem_range and __for_each_mem_range_rev and for_each_mem_range and for_each_mem_range_rev and for_each_reserved_mem_range and for_each_mem_pfn_range and for_each_free_mem_range and for_each_free_mem_range_reverse and for_each_mem_region and for_each_reserved_mem_region.

Reservation helpers named memblock_reserve and memblock_reserve_kern mark fixed ranges as generic reserve or kernel reserve on no specific node, while allocation helpers named memblock_phys_alloc and memblock_alloc and memblock_alloc_or_panic and memblock_alloc_raw and memblock_alloc_from and memblock_alloc_low and memblock_alloc_node provide physical ranges or virtual memory with low and accessible bounds plus panic on failure plus raw plus minimum address constrained plus low address constrained plus node targeted variants.

Allocation direction is stored as a boolean with a setter named memblock_set_bottom_up and a getter named memblock_bottom_up, while initialization section attributes named __init_memblock and __initdata_memblock collapse to memory init sections or to empty depending on configuration with discard becoming a no operation in the latter case.

Region flag queries named memblock_is_hotpluggable and memblock_is_mirror and memblock_is_nomap and memblock_is_reserved_noinit and memblock_is_driver_managed and memblock_is_kho_scratch each report the corresponding bit.
Region node identity helpers named memblock_set_region_node and memblock_get_region_node store and retrieve the identity on NUMA builds but ignore stores and report zero on loads otherwise.

Frame number conversions named memblock_region_memory_base_pfn and memblock_region_memory_end_pfn round memory bases upward and memory ends downward to contained frames, while conversions named memblock_region_reserved_base_pfn and memblock_region_reserved_end_pfn round reserved bases downward and reserved ends upward to covering frames.
Helpers named early_memtest and memtest_report_meminfo and memblock_set_kho_scratch_only and memblock_clear_kho_scratch_only are no operations in this configuration.

Group statistics extend node statistics with counters named MEMCG_SWAP and MEMCG_SOCK and MEMCG_PERCPU_B and MEMCG_KMEM and MEMCG_ZSWAP_B and MEMCG_ZSWAPPED and MEMCG_ZSWAP_INCOMP terminated by MEMCG_NR_STAT, and memory events enumerate conditions named MEMCG_LOW and MEMCG_HIGH and MEMCG_MAX and MEMCG_OOM and MEMCG_OOM_KILL and MEMCG_OOM_GROUP_KILL and MEMCG_SWAP_HIGH and MEMCG_SWAP_MAX and MEMCG_SWAP_FAIL and MEMCG_SOCK_THROTTLED terminated by MEMCG_NR_MEMORY_EVENTS, while the structure named mem_cgroup_reclaim_cookie pairs a node descriptor named pgdat with a generation number named generation.
The shift named MEM_CGROUP_ID_SHIFT denotes sixteen.

The structure named mem_cgroup_private_id pairs a numeric identifier named id with a reference count named ref, while the structure named mem_cgroup_reclaim_iter pairs a position pointer named position with an atomic scan generation named generation.

Per node group state named mem_cgroup_per_node starts with a back pointer named memcg plus per CPU statistics named lruvec_stats_percpu plus aggregate statistics named lruvec_stats plus shrinker info named shrinker_info, then carries legacy tree node plus excess usage plus on tree flag or explicit padding to avoid false sharing, then holds a reclaim vector named lruvec plus per zone per list sizes named lru_zone_size plus a reclaim iterator named iter plus object group pointers named objcg and orig_objcg plus an inherited list named objcg_list plus optionally atomic slab counters.

Notification state named mem_cgroup_threshold pairs an event file named eventfd with a usage limit named threshold, and the array named mem_cgroup_threshold_ary tracks the currently satisfied index named current_threshold plus sized limit entries named entries with size named size, and the container named mem_cgroup_thresholds keeps primary and spare arrays so unregistration can always succeed with capacity for one fewer entry.

Foreign writeback tracking sized by MEMCG_CGWB_FRN_CNT for four entries uses a record named memcg_cgwb_frn with backing device identity named bdi_id plus group identity named memcg_id plus dirty time named at plus completion state named done, while the structure named obj_cgroup combines a per CPU reference named refcnt plus owning group pointer named memcg plus charged byte count named nr_charged_bytes plus a list or reclaim head union plus a root marker named is_root.
Inherited object group lists named objcg_list are serialized by a dedicated lock named objcg_lock, while shrinker info and current object group pointers use read copy update protection.

Signed LRU tallies may briefly appear negative during reparenting so callers must not treat negativity as corruption, and threshold spare storage must accommodate all but one primary entry to preserve infallible unregistration.
Header inclusion guards named _LINUX_KMSAN_STRING_H and _LINUX_KMSAN_TYPES_H and _LRU_LIST_H and _LINUX_MEMBLOCK_H and _LINUX_MEMCONTROL_H each prevent multiple inclusion.
